results.title: Roundup: Spaulding sinks Mill River, 26-7
results.description: BARRE - Spaulding football coach Adam Chase knows that some elements of each game are out of his team’s hands, but controlling the clock is a prime objective this season.

results.title: NBA trade rumor: Miami Heat could send 6-foot-6 star for Dallas Mavericks’ $347million 9x All-Star and NBA champion
results.description: The Dallas Mavericks has been adamant in their stance against trading Kyrie Irving, regardless of the ongoing trade discussions. Yet, some executives speculate that a poor start to the season may prompt a change of heart. The Miami Heat is reportedly keen to acquire Irving, with Andrew Wiggins and Nikola Jovic suggested as possible trade assets that could enhance Miami's roster prospects.

results.title: Knox County football scores: Danville tops Fredericktown, Centerburg wins
results.description: Friday night's Knox County football scores included Danville's 52-7 win over Fredericktown, Centerburg's victory against East Knox and Johnstown-Monroe's win over Mount Vernon.

results.title: Balanced offensive attack leads Monroe football to road victory over North Brunswick
results.description: Monroe QB and RB account for 5 TDs in road win over North Brunswick.

results.title: Framber Valdez, Tigers send Rockies to fifth consecutive loss
results.description: Dillon Dingler hit a two-run homer, Max Clark supplied a solo shot and the host Detroit Tigers pulled away for a 6-2 home victory over the Colorado Rockies on Friday night.

results.title: Alexander Zverev Beats Karen Khachanov To Enter US Open Final
results.description: Alexander Zverev beat Karen Khachanov 6-3, 7-6 (9/7), 7-6 (8/6) to reach his third straight Grand Slam final.

results.title: Former Oilers goaltender Connor Ingram retires from NHL
